prTitle: HOK-3382: Recover hung native harnesses through the controller
summary: A green, wm:ready PR did not merge until an operator ran its eval by hand and edited task state: the eval judge prompt was 3,810,241 bytes (3,728,528 of them the gh pr diff), all three judge candidates failed with an empty is_error, and the mill retried the identical prompt without a typed failure.

evalJob.candidateFailure: claude CLI returned is_error with no message
evalJob.afterExhaustion: challenge pair parked as manual comparison needed

evalAskedGitHub.note: GitHub ignores .gitattributes -diff and returns the full text of both regenerated validators.

localGit.note: Local git honours .gitattributes -diff, so each regenerated validator is one `Binary files ... differ` line.

operatorUnstick.action: re-run tools/run-eval-hook.ts with WAVEMILL_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES=1500000 (forces the local-git fallback), then set evalCompleted on the task row and clear the challenge-eval-hard retry bucket
